free_tier_limits: Free non-member access: 5 requests/minute, 50/hour, and 125/day. Higher limits require membership; commercial users need an agreement. Complimentary EDU and qualifying LSO memberships are available.
rate_limits: Default authenticated limits are 5 requests/minute, 50/hour, and 125/day, applied concurrently on rolling windows. Membership tiers increase limits up to 25/minute, 300/hour, and 1,400/day; grandfathered or commercial limits may differ.
